The catalog now holds 116 recipe files.

- New recipes cover church and civil registers in more countries, censuses and population lists, court, prison, asylum and school files, land, tax and livestock-brand records, U.S. military service, migration and origin sources, Russian Empire and Soviet records, German, Irish and British record systems, place names, maps, libraries and manuscript collections.
- New family-collection recipes cover family papers, photographs, Bible registers and interviews with relatives. The photograph recipes keep the rule that an assistant never compares faces or names anyone by appearance.
- DNA additions cover admixture-model scope and staged outreach to matches.
- Refined recipes keep more recovery and checking steps: index-to-original recovery, coverage and version checks for archival images, saved-fact checks on record sites, census informant and household evidence, newspaper court and reprint leads, burial evidence, land, tax and federal entry files, and DNA side labels. Where a new recipe owns a full procedure, the older recipe hands off to it.
- Source notes cite the works themselves with titles and dates and credit third-party material as third-party. `SKILL.md` and the README route every recipe by topic.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Kinprove/genealogy-research-recipes/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0
